questions.question: You must yield to children playing in the street.
questions.explanation: You must drive carefully around children. Slow down near schools, playgrounds, and residential areas.

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road. What should you do?

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the pavement.
Speed up and steer back onto the pavement gradually.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Gently apply the brakes to slow down. Then turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently apply the brakes to slow down. Then turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, keep driving on the shoulder. Slow down by gently using the brakes. Once you reach a safe speed, turn the wheel to get back on the pavement. Do not jerk the steering wheel sharply.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: Drive through if there is no traffic coming.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light is used at dangerous intersections. Treat it the same way you treat a stop sign.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make many decisions while driving. Any extra activity can distract you and create danger. Keep your full attention on the road.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, what should you do?

options.text: Stop your vehicle at or near the scene.
Do not stand or walk in traffic lanes.
Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.explanation: Stop at or near the accident scene. Move your vehicle away from traffic if you can. Stay out of traffic lanes so other cars do not hit you. Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with black markings on white. Drivers must follow the instructions on all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: Failure to yield the right-of-way is the leading cause of accidents in Nevada.
questions.explanation: Right-of-way rules help traffic flow smoothly. They encourage courtesy and safety. Not yielding the right-of-way causes more accidents in Nevada than anything else.

questions.question: When driving in fog, what lights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. If your vehicle has fog lights, use them too. High beams shine upward and bounce off fog, making it harder to see.

questions.question: How can you avoid a truck or bus driver's blind spot?

options.text: Do not drive alongside them and do not tailgate them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive alongside them and do not tailgate them.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles like trucks and buses have large blind spots on the sides and rear. Stay out of these areas by not driving beside them and not following too closely.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots?

options.text: By looking in your side mirrors.
By turning your head and looking over your shoulders.
By looking in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: By turning your head and looking over your shoulders.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Check them by turning your head and looking over your shoulders.

questions.question: Two solid white lines across a traffic lane mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Vehicles have the right-of-way over pedestrians in crosswalks.
Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of all traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show where pedestrians can safely cross. They may have horizontal lines, vertical lines, or both. You must always stop for pedestrians crossing in a crosswalk.

questions.question: Alcohol:
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant drug that slows brain activity and reduces safe driving skills. It slows reaction time and impairs judgment.

questions.question: You have a green light at an intersection. Pedestrians are crossing against the red. You should:

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrians.
Stop and let the pedestrians cross safely.
Drive close to the pedestrians to scare them so they won't cross against a red light again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrians cross safely.
questions.explanation: Yield to pedestrians and cars already in the intersection, even with a green light. Always be careful around pedestrians.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash:
questions.explanation: If in a crash, stop and move your vehicle off the road if possible. If anyone is hurt, call 911. Report the crash to police if someone is injured, someone dies, or there is over $1,000 in property damage (or over $200 in damage to government property like signs or guardrails).

questions.question: To check your blind spot before changing lanes:

options.text: Look in the left side mirror.
Look in the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median or divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: If someone has drunk alcohol, what will help them get over its effects?
questions.explanation: Only time will allow alcohol to leave a person's body.

questions.question: After being stopped by police, a driver should immediately exit the vehicle and quickly walk toward the officer's car.
questions.explanation: If stopped by police, stay in your vehicle with both hands visible on the steering wheel.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your vehicle. You should:

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be ready to stop whenever you see pedestrians on or crossing the road. Be extra careful around children. Always let pedestrians cross first in a crosswalk.

questions.question: You should slow down:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, near pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: When a funeral procession is present, ____ has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Drivers, pedestrians, and bicyclists must yield to funeral processions. Once the first vehicle enters an intersection, all other vehicles in the procession can follow, even if the traffic light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: At a four-way stop:

options.text: The driver who arrives first has the right-of-way.
The driver who arrives last has the right-of-way.
One driver should continue without stopping.
One driver should wave the others ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver who arrives first has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: All vehicles must stop at a four-way stop. The first vehicle to reach the intersection goes first. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the right goes first.

questions.question: When it starts to rain while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Drive closely behind the car in front of you.

questions.explanation: When rain makes it hard to see, reduce your speed and turn on your headlights. If rain is so heavy you cannot see clearly, pull to the side of the road and stop until it improves.

questions.question: If a police officer stops you, you should:

options.text: Unbuckle your seat belt and lower your window.
Get your paperwork ready before the officer reaches your car.
Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
Get out of your car and walk toward the patrol car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
questions.explanation: Keep your hands on the wheel and have your passengers keep their hands visible. Stay in your vehicle unless the officer tells you to get out. Wait for the officer to ask for your driver license, registration, and insurance information.

questions.question: When driving near a blind pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog, you should:

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When you see a blind pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog, you must slow down, let them cross, and be ready to stop to keep them safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming and you should prepare to stop or proceed carefully.

questions.question: Which of these commonly causes traffic accidents?

options.text: Not paying attention to the road
Driving too fast for the conditions

questions.explanation: Speeding causes many crashes. Not paying attention can cause you to hit other vehicles. Most rear-end crashes happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: If a flagger is directing traffic in a construction zone, you must:

options.text: Copy what other cars are doing, even if the flagger says something else.
Assume the flagger should not be directing traffic.
Follow normal traffic laws instead of the flagger's directions.

questions.explanation: You must slow down and follow the directions of a flagger, sign, or police officer in a construction zone. Not doing so is illegal and dangerous to workers.
